The app

Native Mac controls · Embedded Slate browser

Synthetic test data shown. Your workbook stays on your Mac.

From workbook to storefront

  1. Choose your workbook. Select the visible weekly worksheet.
  2. Sign in to Slate. Use the app’s private browser session.
  3. Run the update. Choose full content updates or carousel order only.
  4. Publish the order. Review the result and confirm the final storefront order.

Two update modes

Full Update adds missing titles and reorders the leading six, preserving existing extras. Each carousel save applies immediately.

Order Only changes storefront carousel order. Top 10 stays first; existing extra rails are preserved.

Private by design

Workbook parsing happens locally. Title searches and updates go to Amazon. Sign-in sessions and reports stay in memory unless you export a report.
